note: Review thresholds for the model integrity audit (lib/edgedesk_model_integrity.js, tools/model_integrity/build.js). Each is an INVESTIGATION TRIGGER, not statistical proof of an error. engine/model_integrity.json publishes, beside every build, how games beyond each threshold have actually gone (threshold_validation); change a number here only with that record in hand, and say so in the pull request.

nba.basis: initial review threshold (2026-10-26 audit brief): |model unrounded margin - market home line| > 3 points

nhl.basis: initial review thresholds (2026-10-26 audit brief): model win probability against the no-vig moneyline, in percentage points; expected total against the market total, in goals

quote.basis: a quote older than this before the projection is shown, never compared

signal.basis: VALIDATED_INDEPENDENT_SIGNAL needs the market validated against the close (engine/registry.json) AND at least min_n graded disagreements beyond the threshold whose model-side win rate's Wilson 95% lower bound clears the -110 break-even, AND clean inputs
